author: Scotese, C. R. and Wright, N. M.
citation: Scotese, C. R., & Wright, N. M. (2018). PALEOMAP Paleodigital Elevation Models (PaleoDEMs) for the Phanerozoic. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5460860
archive: sources/paleodem.json pins the Zenodo archives by SHA-256

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.note: License.txt inside each archive states CC BY 4.0.

processing: scripts/build_paleodem.py resamples each grid to an equirectangular texture: red is the signed coastline distance at the 0 m contour, green the high byte of elevation over -9000..6000 m and blue four more bits. Frames are the 109 grids, 0-540 Ma at 5 Myr; period labels come from the age with ICS boundaries, the English title from the file name.
